tone_breaks.line: The decks are better designed than your minute papers were. They say the same things, and they cost $1.9 million.
tone_breaks.note: Funny, but it's the game nudging us to laugh at consultants. It felt like the writer talking, not the story.

tone_breaks.line: YOUR CEILING: When you joined, your file put no ceiling on you inside the service. Most people's files do.
tone_breaks.note: I didn't really get this. It sounds like a comment on the scholarship system but I don't know the details, so it went over my head.

answer.title_fit_why: My run was all about appraisals, grades and being 'solid and dependable', not the pay. I never got near minister-level money. The title Minister Salary makes it sound like a different game from the one I played.
